notes: Every trophy unlocks in single player. There are no online trophies.
Turning on a cheat disables trophies and saving, so keep cheats off for the whole run.
Positive Mental Attitude is the only trophy reported as possibly missable: meditate at every spot you find, and keep a manual save before story missions that change the map.
Hidden trophies stay hidden on PSN until they are earned. Their names can spoil story missions, so this guide hides them behind the spoiler setting until you earn them or switch spoilers on.

sources.name: PSNProfiles and Exophase — official trophy names and descriptions, via Planet GTA 6
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — missable flag and the cheat rule
GTABase — meditation spots and missable warning

trophies.guide: The platinum lands the moment the other 54 trophies are all yours, so there is no separate task here. Work the roadmap in order — story first, then strangers and robberies, then the collectible and activity grind — and this pops at the end of a run of roughly 200 hours.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and the trophy pops when it ends. It is the first story beat of the game, so you cannot miss it — just follow the mission markers and finish the job.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Clear every mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy unlocks as the chapter closes. While you are in Chapter 1, meditate at the balcony spot at Jason's house after the Down to Earth mission — that first meditation spot feeds the missable Positive Mental Attitude trophy, so do it before the chapter ends.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish all of Chapter 2's missions and this unlocks at the chapter's end. Keep meditating at every spot you pass on the way — the meditation count carries across the whole game and only the spots you skip can hurt you.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3 to its end and the trophy is yours. By now Vice City itself is open to you, so use the travel between missions to start the exploration and vehicle-discovery counts.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete every mission in Chapter 4 and this pops as the chapter wraps up. The story is nearing its endgame now, so make a manual save before the final stretch of missions in case you want to revisit any choice later.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: The gold for finishing the game: complete the final story mission. Keep a manual save from just before the ending missions, so you can replay the finale without starting over if you want a different outcome.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the Breakfast Run mission when it appears in the story. It is a story mission, so it comes to you — play it when the marker shows up and the trophy pops at its end.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist mission when the story brings it to you. It is one of the bigger set-piece jobs, so stock up on ammo and armour before you start it, then follow the crew's plan through to the getaway.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the Child's Play mission when it shows up in the story. Like the other mission trophies it unlocks by playing the story in order — no side task is needed, just finish the job.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the Headliners mission when the story reaches it. Headliners is a story mission like the rest, so keep playing the main thread and the trophy pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the VCIA Takedown mission when it appears in the story. The job takes you to the airport, so expect heavy resistance on the way in — bring a strong weapon and a fast escape vehicle.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the Operation Savage Glory mission when the story reaches it. It is a late-story operation, so come prepared with full health, armour and ammo, then push through to the mission's end.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the game. Open the in-game 100% checklist and clear every line of it: the full story, every stranger strand, all activities, all robberies and every collectible set. Use this guide's roadmap and the checklist below to track what is left, and expect around 200 hours for the full platinum run.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 unique stunts across Leonida. Stunt jumps, ramps and long air time all count toward the total, so keep a fast bike or car handy and hit the stunt jump spots marked around the map as you travel. The count only grows on stunts you have not done before, so spread out instead of repeating one ramp.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample each of the 9 activity types once: races, fishing, arcade games, the shooting range, drone races, challenges, meditation and the other open-world activities. You only need one taste of each, so this is a quick trophy early on — just try everything once.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Learn each range's target pattern first, use the weapon the challenge recommends, and replay a challenge until you beat its gold time or score. Take them a few at a time between missions rather than grinding all 42 in one sitting.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every drone race location in Leonida. Learn each course's corners, cut the racing line tight, and retry the locations you lose until you have won them all. A win at each location is what counts, so one clean win per course is enough.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Enter races across the map with a fast, well-handling vehicle; each distinct race you win counts once, so spread your wins across different events instead of replaying the same one. Street, off-road and water races all count toward the 20.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Match the right bait and spot to the fish Cal is after, keep the tension steady on the line, and reel him in without snapping it. If you lose, challenge him again — the trophy only needs one win.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete any arcade game. Find an arcade machine in Leonida, pick the game you find easiest, and play it through to the end. Any single completion counts, so choose the shortest game on the machine.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand. Take every mission Andy offers when his icon appears on the map and play through to his final mission. Stranger strands unlock as you explore, so check the map for his icon between story missions.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand. Answer every mission Kenton offers when his icon appears and play through to his final mission. His strand counts toward the 8 strands needed for Strangers & Freaks, so it does double duty.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand. Take every mission Billy offers when his icon appears and play through to his final mission. Keep an eye on the map while you travel — stranger icons appear as you unlock new areas.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Watch for the stranger icons on the map, start each strand, and finish all of its missions. The five named side characters — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — count toward this total, so their strands plus three more finish it.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand. Take every mission Randy offers when his icon appears and play through to his final mission. Randy's strand is one of the five named ones that count toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand. Take every mission Tyrone offers when his icon appears and play through to his final mission. His strand also counts toward the 8 strands for Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: POSSIBLY MISSABLE — the only trophy the guides flag as possibly missable (PowerPyx, GTABase). Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. The first spot is Lucia meditating on the balcony at Jason's house after the Down to Earth mission in Chapter 1 — do it before Chapter 1 ends. After that, meditate at every spot you find and keep a manual save before story missions that change the map. The 100% checklist needs only 15 of the 18, but this trophy needs all 18.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Take Bret's hunting strand, track the animal he names, and bring it down with a clean shot. Use a scoped rifle and approach quietly — a spooked animal runs and the hunt takes much longer.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida; collect full sets and use a map of card locations to find the ones you are missing. Cards are scattered in shops, hideouts and open-world spots, so grab every card you pass while doing other things.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations across Leonida. Open the WAiNK app at scenic spots and viewpoints as you explore — the counter tracks each new location, so keep using it wherever you travel. A good habit is to open WAiNK It at every viewpoint, beach and landmark you pass, which also helps the exploration count.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges appear across activities and the open world — stunt jumps, races, shooting and more — so tick them off as you play and check the challenges list for the ones you have not tried yet. Most of them complete naturally while you chase the other trophies.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops together. Break line of sight, use alleys and tunnels, and stay out of the search area until the stars clear. The partner must be with you when the stars drop for it to count.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level. Pick three shops close together, move fast between them, and keep the heat low so the streak is not broken. Plan the route first — a shop near a getaway car saves precious seconds.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive everything you see — cars, bikes, boats and more — and explore car parks, dealerships and traffic across Leonida to log new models. Each new model you drive counts once, so variety matters more than mileage.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus. Trigger it in a busy firefight with enemies grouped together, aim for quick headshots, and keep the chain going before the focus ends. A crowded gang shootout is the best place to try it.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport. Get to the airfield, grab a plane, and take off without following the usual departure — expect airport security to notice, so be ready for a wanted level the moment you lift off.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Get behind the wheel of a Rhino tank. Find one at a military site, take it for a spin, and survive the wanted attention that follows. The tank itself is slow, so plan your route before you climb in.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store first, strike when the staff are distracted, grab the goods quietly and leave before the alarm goes up. If anyone spots you, the trophy fails — so patience beats speed here.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Plan a fast getaway car for every vault, hit the vault, and lose the cops before the next one — five clean escapes in total. Space the vaults out between other jobs so you are never low on supplies.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Stop the truck, crack it open, grab the cash and get away before the police box you in. A sticky bomb or a heavy vehicle makes stopping the truck much easier.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Drive, fly and sail into every region — Vice City, the beaches, the swamps and the countryside — until the whole map is revealed. Flying a plane or helicopter across the state is the fastest way to fill in the last corners.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida. Find each gang's operation, hit it, and escape; repeat until every gang has been robbed once. The operations are spread across the map, so work them into your travel between other jobs.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a beachfront bar on Ocean Drive, order a cocktail, and take in the view. Any beachfront bar on the strip counts, so stop in the next time you are passing.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic GTA style. Drive a car through the showroom's glass front and out onto the street. Pick up speed inside the showroom and aim straight for the glass — the trophy pops as you burst out.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through on a game. Bowl a full game there and the trophy is yours. It is a quiet one — just walk in, play the game to the end, and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The exact unlock is still being confirmed by the community, so check the latest reports before chasing it — KeenGamer and the trophy forums track it as new findings come in. Do not spend hours on an unverified method.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make a story choice. This pops from a decision in the story — play through and choose when the game asks you to. There is no wrong answer for the trophy; any choice at the decision point counts.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Retry something you failed at once and succeed on the second attempt — the exact trigger is still being confirmed by the community, so if it has not popped, keep an eye on the latest trophy reports for the confirmed method.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: A hidden trophy with an unconfirmed unlock method (KeenGamer). It likely involves a strange encounter out in Leonida — do not rely on unverified methods for this one, and check the community's latest findings as they are confirmed.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl pedestrians over with a melee drive-by. Swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle into a group and knock them down like bowling pins. A slow drive past a busy sidewalk with a bat in hand is the simplest way to line it up.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Collect Marked Bills from jobs and robberies, then launder them through your contacts until you have cleaned a quarter of a million. The total adds up across the whole game, so bank robberies and big jobs feed it fastest.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, weapons, cars and upgrades as you play; the total adds up across every shop in Leonida. Big purchases like vehicles and property upgrades move the counter fastest.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Save up and buy every garage on the market — they also give you somewhere to store your best rides. Check the property listings regularly and buy each garage as soon as you can afford it.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app, register the vehicles you find around Leonida, and repeat until you have logged ten. Any ten vehicles count, so register the ones you drive every day.
trophies.name: On the Spot
